hero.subtitle: Vand yubaka software zihariye, porogaramu za web na mobile, ndetse n'ibicuruzwa byayo bwite — byubatswe kugira ngo bihute, byizewe kandi bimare igihe.

services.title: Software, kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku musozo.
services.subtitle: Kuva ku gitekerezo cya mbere kugeza ku gicuruzwa kigera ku bantu — turabishushanya, tukabyubaka, tukabitanga.

custom.title: Software zihariye
custom.body: Sisitemu na porogaramu zubakiwe uko ubucuruzi bwawe bukora koko.

apps.title: Porogaramu za web na mobile
apps.body: Porogaramu za web na mobile zihuta kandi zizewe abakoresha bawe bazakunda.

products.title: Ibicuruzwa byacu bwite
products.body: Ntitwubakira abandi gusa — twubaka kandi tukayobora ibicuruzwa byacu, nka Menyesha.

products.title: Ibicuruzwa twubaka kandi tuyobora.
products.subtitle: Dushora imari mu bitekerezo byacu — dutanga ibicuruzwa bikoreshwa n'abantu nyabo mu Rwanda.

menyesha.tagline: Aho Abanyarwanda bakurikirira amakuru n'imikino y'umupira ku buryo bwihuse, bugenewe telefone, kandi mu rurimi rwawe.

features.live: Amanota, imikino, ibisubizo n'imbonerahamwe, bivugururwa ako kanya.
features.news: Amakuru ashyushye n'inkuru mu mikino no mu bindi.

about.title: Byakorewe mu Rwanda, ku isi yose.
about.lead: Vand ni ikigo cya software gifite intego yo kubaka ikoranabuhanga rituma ubuzima bwa buri munsi buba bwiza — dutangiriye iwacu mu Rwanda.
about.body: Duhuza ubunyabuki bukomeye n'ibitekerezo nyabyo by'ibicuruzwa. Twaba twubakira umukiriya cyangwa dutangiza igicuruzwa cyacu, twita ku birango, dutanga vuba, kandi twubaka ibimara igihe.

rooted.title: Dushingiye iwacu
rooted.body: Twubaka twita ku muco wacu mbere — bugenewe telefone, indimi nyinshi, kandi bigenewe uko abantu babaho.

craft.title: Byubatswe n'ubuhanga
craft.body: Ubunyabuki busukuye n'igishushanyo cyitondewe, kuva ku rupapuro rwa mbere kugeza ku bibazo bike.

partner.title: Umufatanyabikorwa nyawe
partner.body: Dukorana namwe, atari ukubakorera gusa — kuva ku gitekerezo kugeza ku itangizwa n'ikirenga.

contact.title: Reka twubake ikintu.
contact.subtitle: Ufite umushinga mu mutwe, cyangwa ushaka gukorana natwe? Twakwishimira kukumva.

footer.tagline: Ikigo cya software kubaka ibisubizo n'ibicuruzwa — kuva mu Rwanda kugeza ku isi.
